verdict.rationale: PostHog documents version-like mechanics for pieces of its automation stack: Skills are described as 'versioned, reusable instructions for AI agents' with 'every edit creates an immutable version, with base_version concurrency checks' (review/rollback via version history), and the self-driving loop routes agent-made changes through PRs 'you review and merge' (git-native review/revert). Feature flags can be toggled off instantly as a rollback mechanism. However, there's no dedicated versioning/rollback UI for Workflows or CDP destinations, and no explicit 'revert to previous skill version' action documented. Missing for 10: explicit rollback UI/history for Workflows automations, explicit revert action for Skills versions, and independent/hands-on confirmation of rollback working in practice.
